ea_clause_text: Official (article 12381265): 'Atmos supports the use of Expert Advisors (EAs), bots, but some strategies are not allowed.' Allowed: EAs you build yourself (purchased/public/third-party EAs do not qualify), copy trading only between own Atmos accounts. Not allowed: latency arbitrage, high-frequency bots that overload execution, tick scalping/toxic flow. Prohibited-strategies article also lists HFT rule violation (fewer than half of trades held over two minutes). VPS not mentioned [uncertain].
overnight_weekend: Official (article 12381252): Atmos Funded allows traders to hold trades overnight and over weekends across all account types. Prohibited-strategies article: holding overnight/weekends is permitted. No BTC-specific weekend rule found.

drawdown: Official: Instant max daily loss 3%, max total drawdown 5% trailing; drawdown locks at initial balance once a payout is requested. Per-trade risk cap not found.
consistency_min_days: Official: 20% consistency (no single day above 20% of total profit, equity-based); minimum trading days: none.
first_payout: Official: 14-day payout cycle, first payout 14 days after start, then every 14 days; profit split up to 90% with add-ons. Minimum payout amount not stated [uncertain].
news_gambling: Official: no opening/closing trades within +/-2 minutes of high-impact news on Instant (funded-stage rule from the start); holding through news allowed. Anti-gambling policy exists; all-in gambling-style trading and cross-account hedging prohibited.
